irreducible_residue: 404.html always emitted (no config switch to disable); nothing injected into authored pages
features_manual: content generation from data.json (Zola has no data->pages mechanism; gen_content.py emits one .md per stock every build)
sitemap format (built-in emits its own layout; templates/sitemap.xml override needed for parity — but unlike Hugo/Astro the override is possible)
explicit path frontmatter per page (default slugify lowercases /stocks/KO/ -> /stocks/ko/)
conformance_checks: zola check exists (internal+external link checker) but reads markdown content only — it cannot see template-emitted hrefs, which is every link on this site; separate command, does not gate build; no title/sitemap/canonical checks
notes: Byte-parity (raw=0 all files) on the first successful build: Tera untrimmed whitespace semantics are identical to minijinja, strongest confirmation of finding #1. Friction: one config.toml field guessed wrong (unknown field error was clear), section _index.md with render=false needed so /stocks/ has no page of its own. Big-build cost is dominated by the mandatory generation step (451 of 846 ms); zola build alone on 1,901 pre-generated pages is 424 ms. Installed with `brew install zola` (41 MB single binary, bottle).
